We develop a sound and complete technique for the parametric verification of address space separation.

developing techniques that allow for the automated verification of systems with a high degree of parametricity and complexity, such as the address translation subsystems of modern operating systems, hypervisor, and virtual machine managers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we developed a new technique for model checking that achieves significant reductions in model size and that we used the new technique to model-check the shadow paging mechanism of two different systems.

we have developed a new parametric verification technique for address translation subsystems that is sound, complete, and efficient, and have applied this technique to verify the correctness of shadow paging mechanisms in Xen and ShadowVisor.

The main takeaway from our work is that
parametric verification is an important tool for the analysis of large-scale, complex systems, and can be used to verify properties of practical interest in a scalable manner.
parametric verification is a powerful technique that can be fruitfully applied in practice to verify systems with a large number of parameters.
, with appropriate abstraction, it is possible to verify large systems with complex data structures using off-the-shelf model checking tools.
